Artifact.description: One immutable file belonging to a revision or run.

produced_by.description: Owning team, so a consumer can tell a stub from a real producer.
produced_by.title: Produced By

relative_path.description: Path relative to the revision directory. Never an absolute or escaping path.
relative_path.title: Relative Path

role.description: design_manifest | parts | graph | evaluation | step | glb | ...
role.title: Role

Artifact.title: Artifact

AuditEvent.description: One immutable log line. There is deliberately no field for model reasoning.

inputs_summary.description: Short scalars only. Never a payload dump.
inputs_summary.title: Inputs Summary

sequence.description: Monotonic per design. The SSE last-event-id.
sequence.title: Sequence

tool_name.description: The tool or service function that ran.
tool_name.title: Tool Name

AuditEvent.title: AuditEvent

CadEditResult.description:
``cad_edit_result.json`` - A's tool, called by B, consumed by everyone.

``ok`` false means the edit did not produce valid geometry. B never promotes such a preview.

downloadable.description:
Section 6: download requires a successful round trip. Serialised for the same reason
as ``passed`` - the UI must not re-derive whether a file may be offered.
downloadable.title: Downloadable

produced_by.description: B-stub marks the reference CAD port B uses until Team A's kernel lands.
produced_by.title: Produced By

CadEditResult.title: CadEditResult

CatalogItem.description: One catalog part: its claims, its declared interfaces, and its offers.
CatalogItem.title: CatalogItem

CatalogOffer.description: A purchasable offer. Synthetic entries may not name a supplier or link a product.

source_url.description: Where the figures were read, for a verified entry.
source_url.title: Source Url

synthetic.description: A clearly labelled demo entry with no implied real supplier offer.
synthetic.title: Synthetic

CatalogOffer.title: CatalogOffer

CatalogSnapshot.description: The frozen, checked-in catalog. Live supplier search is optional and never required.

all_synthetic.description: True when every offer in the snapshot is a demo entry.
all_synthetic.title: All Synthetic

CatalogSnapshot.title: CatalogSnapshot

CheckRegistry.description: The versioned set of checks a mission profile requires. Frozen by construction.
CheckRegistry.title: CheckRegistry

CheckResult.description: One check outcome. ``unknown`` is a legitimate result and must not be coerced to a pass.
CheckResult.title: CheckResult

Claim.description:
A single asserted quantity with its provenance.

``value is None`` means unknown. It does not mean zero, and it may not carry a confidence.

assumptions.description: Declared modelling assumptions this value depends on.
assumptions.title: Assumptions

confidence.description: Optional and uncalibrated unless a calibration record is cited. Not a statistical probability.
confidence.title: Confidence

Claim.title: Claim

ClaimSet.description: Named claims for one entity, plus any preserved conflicts.
ClaimSet.title: ClaimSet

ComparisonPair.description:
Baseline and candidate evaluated at identical conditions (architecture section 8).

Construction fails if the two sides used different missions, registries, or fidelity tiers, so
an analytic baseline can never be subtracted from a VSPAERO-informed candidate.
ComparisonPair.title: ComparisonPair

ConflictSet.description:
Conflicting claims for one quantity, preserved with an explicit selection and rationale.

Architecture section 5: never silently alter evidence. Every candidate stays; the selection
and the reason for it are recorded alongside them.
ConflictSet.title: ConflictSet

DecisionOutcome.description: What a decision did. A repeated idempotency key returns this object unchanged.

active_revision_id.description: The active revision after the decision. A decline leaves it untouched.
active_revision_id.title: Active Revision Id

replayed.description: True when this outcome was returned from the idempotency store.
replayed.title: Replayed

DecisionOutcome.title: DecisionOutcome

DecisionRequest.description: An accept or decline. The four fields on an accept are what make CAS possible.

preview_hash.description: Required on accept: the exact preview the user reviewed.
preview_hash.title: Preview Hash

reason.description: Optional note, recorded on a decline.
reason.title: Reason

DecisionRequest.title: DecisionRequest

DeclaredInterface.description: A machine-checkable interface. ``compatible_with`` is computed only from these.
DeclaredInterface.title: DeclaredInterface

excluded_alternatives.description: Variant bodies deliberately not installed. They must not count as mass.
excluded_alternatives.title: Excluded Alternatives

ErrorEnvelope.description: The single error shape every endpoint and CLI command returns.
ErrorEnvelope.title: ErrorEnvelope

inputs_used.description: Section 8: report inputs and unknowns before numbers.
inputs_used.title: Inputs Used

omitted_physics.description: Openly listed. A short list here is what keeps the numbers honest.
omitted_physics.title: Omitted Physics

produced_by.description: B-stub marks the reference evaluator B uses until Team C's lands.
produced_by.title: Produced By

verified_feasible.description:
True only when nothing blocking fails and nothing blocking is unknown.

Serialised deliberately. The UI must not re-derive feasibility from the check list: that
would put a second definition of "verified" in the codebase, and the two would drift.
verified_feasible.title: Verified Feasible

Evidence.description: One retrievable source record behind a claim.

accessed_at.description: When the source was read. Display-only; excluded from hashes.
accessed_at.title: Accessed At

content_sha256.description: Hash of the source bytes when the source is a retrievable file.
content_sha256.title: Content Sha256

extraction_method.description: How the value was obtained: stl_bounds, manual_entry, catalog_field, ...
extraction_method.title: Extraction Method

locator.description: Page, table, field, body name, or line range in the source.
locator.title: Locator

source_uri.description: URI or repository-relative path of the source
source_uri.title: Source Uri

Evidence.title: Evidence

unknown_relationships.description: Relationships the source material does not determine, stated openly rather than guessed. These drive the 'what evidence is missing' answers in the UI.
unknown_relationships.title: Unknown Relationships

EvidenceRequest.description:
A candidate that asks for a missing fact instead of proposing an edit.

Section 7 step 2 names this explicitly: "ask for missing battery mass before promising
endurance." It is modelled separately from :class:`Recommendation` so the edit-operation union
stays closed - the four operations in section 6 are the only things that can change geometry.

quantity.description: Dotted path of the claim to supply, e.g. prt_harness.mass_kg
quantity.title: Quantity

suggested_source_kinds.description: What would count as adequate evidence. Never 'inferred' for a mass.
suggested_source_kinds.title: Suggested Source Kinds

why_it_matters.description: Which checks are unknown until this is supplied.
why_it_matters.title: Why It Matters

EvidenceRequest.title: EvidenceRequest

ExplanationPath.description: A short typed path answering one of the section 7 narrow queries.

weakest_status.description: The least certain link on the path. An inferred hop caps the whole claim.
weakest_status.title: Weakest Status

ExplanationPath.title: ExplanationPath

GeometryFeatures.description:
``geometry_features.json`` - A -> C/B (architecture section 5).

The single source of wing/tail dimensions. Section 8 forbids the evaluator from maintaining its
own copy, so anything downstream that needs a reference area reads it from here.

fit_error_m.description: Deviation of the reconstruction from the reference silhouette.

frame_confirmed.description: False until units, axes, nose datum, and symmetry have been confirmed.
frame_confirmed.title: Frame Confirmed

neutral_point_station_m.description: Aft-positive station of the neutral point. Architecture section 8 permits a documented synthetic fixture to supply this as an assumption for illustrating the workflow, and requires the report to identify it as assumed. A wing quarter-chord guess does not qualify for a V-tail aircraft, so the validator below refuses any source kind other than 'assumed' until a real stability method produces one.

reconstruction_confirmed.description: A recorded human decision. Engineering comparison is blocked until true.
reconstruction_confirmed.title: Reconstruction Confirmed

GeometryFeatures.title: GeometryFeatures

GraphEdge.description: A typed relation carrying its own evidence, status, and revision scope.

basis.description: Required for compatible_with. Anything other than declared_interfaces is a bug.
basis.title: Basis

GraphEdge.title: GraphEdge

GraphNode.description: A typed node, scoped to one revision.
GraphNode.title: GraphNode

InterferenceFinding.description: An overlap that was *not* a declared mating, bonded, or nesting pair.
InterferenceFinding.title: InterferenceFinding

JobRecord.description: A queued unit of work. Long native work never runs inside an HTTP request thread.

cache_key.description: Covers revision content, mission, solver version and settings, model tier, and the relevant evidence/catalog snapshot hashes.
cache_key.title: Cache Key

reused_job_id.description: Set on a cache hit so the UI can show the reused run.
reused_job_id.title: Reused Job Id

work_dir.description: Unique per job. Native solvers emit many same-named files, so they cannot share.
work_dir.title: Work Dir

JobRecord.title: JobRecord

Mission.description: The locked mission. Its hash pins every evaluation and cache key.

cg_envelope_station_m.description: Aft-positive station bounds (s = -x) for the centre of gravity.
cg_envelope_station_m.title: Cg Envelope Station M

energy_reserve_fraction.description: Withheld before usable energy is computed.
energy_reserve_fraction.title: Energy Reserve Fraction

locked_part_ids.description: Mission payload occurrences that may not be removed or moved.
locked_part_ids.title: Locked Part Ids

stall_margin_fraction.description: Required fraction by which cruise speed exceeds stall speed.
stall_margin_fraction.title: Stall Margin Fraction

static_margin_bounds.description: Acceptable (min, max) static margin as a fraction of MAC. Must be consistent with cg_envelope_station_m and the neutral point, or the two checks contradict each other; the validator below enforces that.
static_margin_bounds.title: Static Margin Bounds

Mission.title: Mission

Neighborhood.description: A bounded subgraph. The whole graph is never sent to a model or rendered at once.

truncated.description: True when the node budget cut the traversal short.
truncated.title: Truncated

Neighborhood.title: Neighborhood

PartDefinition.description: Reusable geometry. Several occurrences may share one definition.

parameters.description: Editable parameters in canonical SI, for reconstructed/generated geometry.
parameters.title: Parameters

PartDefinition.title: PartDefinition

PartOccurrence.description: One installed instance of a definition, at a placement, with its own claims.

allowed_contact_part_ids.description: Declared mating/bonded/nesting partners. Overlap with these is intended engagement, not interference.
allowed_contact_part_ids.title: Allowed Contact Part Ids

local_com_m.description: Centre of mass in the occurrence's own frame, with its own evidence. Absent means the mass distribution is unknown, not that it coincides with the placement datum.
local_com_m.title: Local Com M

locked.description: Mission payload or otherwise not removable/movable.
locked.title: Locked

mirror_of.description: The part_id this occurrence mirrors. Distinct identity, possibly shared asset.
mirror_of.title: Mirror Of

PartOccurrence.title: PartOccurrence

PartSignature.description:
A semantic fingerprint used to prove an unchanged part really did not change.

Section 6 export acceptance: compare semantic geometry, not STEP byte hashes, and do not
require entity numbers or face ordering to remain stable.
PartSignature.title: PartSignature

PartsDocument.description: ``parts.json`` - A -> B/C. Installed occurrences plus their definitions and evidence.
PartsDocument.title: PartsDocument

PathStep.description: One hop of an explanation path.
PathStep.title: PathStep

PreviewResult.description:
The concrete, immutable child revision a proposal was actually evaluated on.

``preview_hash`` is what an acceptance must quote. Accepting anything else is refused, which is
how "accept commits precisely the reviewed preview" becomes mechanical.
PreviewResult.title: PreviewResult

ProposalContext.description:
Exactly what a provider adapter is allowed to see.

Section 7: compute affected constraints with typed traversals; do not send the entire graph to
the model. This object is the whole input surface, and it carries no raw geometry.
ProposalContext.title: ProposalContext

Recommendation.description: One bounded proposal, with its evidence, its preview, and its tradeoffs.

expected_gain_note.description: A provider's narrative expectation, kept only as text. It is never substituted for a computed result and never ranked on.
expected_gain_note.title: Expected Gain Note

issue.description: The specific problem this addresses, in plain language.
issue.title: Issue

prerequisites.description: Facts that had to be known before this was proposable.
prerequisites.title: Prerequisites

Recommendation.title: Recommendation

RecommendationSet.description: ``recommendations.json`` - B -> review UI. Budgeted per section 7.

evidence_requests.description: Asked for before promising a number. These are shown above edit proposals when a required check is unknown, because an edit ranked on unknown inputs is theatre.
evidence_requests.title: Evidence Requests

RecommendationSet.title: RecommendationSet

RegulatoryProfile.description: One jurisdiction and operation profile, chosen in mission setup (architecture section 7).

in_friaa.description: Operating within an FAA-Recognized Identification Area.
in_friaa.title: In Friaa

over_people.description: None means the fact was not supplied, not that it is false.
over_people.title: Over People

RegulatoryProfile.title: RegulatoryProfile

ReplaceCatalogComponent.description:
Swap an envelope/part and its BOM entry atomically.

Unresolved fit or current checks block the commit; they do not merely warn.
ReplaceCatalogComponent.title: ReplaceCatalogComponent

RequiredCheck.description: One check the mission profile requires every evaluation to report.
RequiredCheck.title: RequiredCheck

ResizeSpar.description:
Regenerate a tubular spar, and any mounts included in the same reviewed transaction.

Preconditions: the spar is a reconstructed tube, the material assumption is declared, and the
shaft/wing-hole/connector limits are known.

regenerate_mount_part_ids.description: Compatible mounts regenerated inside the same transaction.
regenerate_mount_part_ids.title: Regenerate Mount Part Ids

ResizeSpar.title: ResizeSpar

mission_hash.description: Hash of the locked mission. Null before a mission is set.
mission_hash.title: Mission Hash

RevisionManifest.description:
``revision_manifest.json`` - B -> all.

The coherent artifact set that became active atomically. A half-applied CAD/BOM/report
combination cannot be represented: either the manifest lists the full set or it does not exist.
RevisionManifest.title: RevisionManifest

RoundTripCheck.description: The export/reimport result. A download is refused without a successful round trip.

passed.description: Serialised so the UI has one definition of a passing round trip, not two.
passed.title: Passed

reimport_worker_fresh.description: Reimport ran in a fresh worker, not the exporting process.
reimport_worker_fresh.title: Reimport Worker Fresh

RoundTripCheck.title: RoundTripCheck

SensitivityInterval.description:
A low/nominal/high span over declared uncertain inputs.

Section 8 is explicit that this is an "assumption range", not a calibrated confidence interval.
The field name and the required label keep that distinction visible downstream.
SensitivityInterval.title: SensitivityInterval

SetWingTipExtension.description: Stretch a parameterised symmetric tip. Regenerates the paired surface too.

paired_part_id.description: The mirrored occurrence regenerated in the same transaction.
paired_part_id.title: Paired Part Id

SetWingTipExtension.title: SetWingTipExtension

SimulationRun.description: ``simulation_run.json`` - C -> UI. Never mutates the design it analysed.

assumptions.description: Section 8: straight-and-level v1 omits maneuver loads and turn drag; animated turns are not a tested turning-flight envelope.
assumptions.title: Assumptions

completed_route.description: False marks an energy-limited run. The route is not silently shortened.
completed_route.title: Completed Route

recorded_fallback.description: A visibly labelled 'Recorded run', not a fresh computation.
recorded_fallback.title: Recorded Fallback

SimulationRun.title: SimulationRun

SolverManifest.description: Exactly which binary produced a result. Required before a solver label may be shown.

geometry_hash.description: Hash of the geometry actually handed to the solver.
geometry_hash.title: Geometry Hash

inputs_discovered_at_runtime.description: Analysis inputs were enumerated from the installed build, not hardcoded.
inputs_discovered_at_runtime.title: Inputs Discovered At Runtime

SolverManifest.title: SolverManifest

SourceRef.description: Where an occurrence's geometry came from, preserved so identity survives re-import.

body_path.description: Body or occurrence path inside the source assembly.
body_path.title: Body Path

variant_decision.description: Which alternative was selected, when the source offered several.
variant_decision.title: Variant Decision

SourceRef.title: SourceRef

TelemetrySample.description: One state along the reduced-order mission model.

remaining_energy_wh.description: Energy usable after the mission reserve has already been withheld. The run terminates at zero; the display is never clamped while flight continues.
remaining_energy_wh.title: Remaining Energy Wh

TelemetrySample.title: TelemetrySample

Tradeoff.description:
One metric that moves, in either direction.

Section 10: a proposal that increases spar margin but increases mass must show both. A
recommendation with only improving tradeoffs and a nonzero mass change is rejected below.

basis.description: Why this direction was assigned, when it came from a check status rather than from the sign of the change.
basis.title: Basis

Tradeoff.title: Tradeoff

Transform.description:
``T_parent_from_local``: row-major 4x4 homogeneous, applied to column vectors.

Translation in metres. A rigid rotation has determinant +1; reflections are rejected here so
that a mirror cannot be smuggled in as a placement.
Transform.title: Transform

TranslateComponent.description:
Move an unlocked movable component along its declared travel corridor.

Preconditions (section 6): the corridor, harness allowance, and mount positions are known.
CAD effect: change the instance placement only. Geometry shapes stay identical, which the
export acceptance check verifies by comparing unchanged-part signatures.
TranslateComponent.title: TranslateComponent

TravelCorridor.description:
The modelled envelope inside which a movable component may be repositioned.

Architecture section 6 makes this a precondition of ``translate_component``: the corridor,
harness allowance, and mount positions must be known before a move is proposable.
TravelCorridor.title: TravelCorridor

VTailPanel.description: A canted tail panel. This airframe has no conventional horizontal-plus-vertical tail.

arm_m.description: Longitudinal distance from the wing quarter-chord to the panel, aft-positive.
arm_m.title: Arm M

VTailPanel.title: VTailPanel

WingStation.description: One spanwise station of the editable parameterisation (architecture section 6).
WingStation.title: WingStation

description: Generated from packages/contracts. Do not hand-edit; run python -m dronebench_contracts.schema instead.
title: DroneBench contracts
